meta.purpose: A clear list of the questions, information and answers that must be resolved before any decision about PARCEL-001 can reasonably be made — separated into what we HAVE, what we DO NOT HAVE, and how each gap gets closed.
meta.rule: Every open question names (a) why it blocks the decision, (b) who holds it, (c) how to discover it, and (d) whether it can be obtained without revealing private data. A question with no discovery path is not a question, it is a wish.

do_not_have.question: What is the parcel's exact location, and therefore its census tract, flood zone, fire zone and submarket?
do_not_have.why_blocks: Every parcel-specific figure in this project is empty because of this. Tract demographics, flood zone, fire severity zone and the whole competitive ring are all downstream of one address.
do_not_have.discovery: Provide the address or APN in the secure workspace only. Then run the three prepared hazard queries in data/hazards.json and the tract pull in data/tradearea.json.
do_not_have.privacy_safe: Yes — the queries return zone classifications that can be summarised without publishing the address.

do_not_have.question: Why did the Census tract pull fail, and can it be made to work?
do_not_have.why_blocks: Blocks W-01 entirely. Without tract data there is no trade area, only city-level averages that the owner correctly rejected as proxies.
do_not_have.holder: Anyone with a Census API key
do_not_have.discovery: The API returned 'Missing Key' for every keyless request. Register a free key at the Census key signup page and re-run the documented query in data/tradearea.json.
do_not_have.privacy_safe: Yes — tract data is public aggregate data.
do_not_have.note: This is the cheapest gap to close and it unlocks the largest block of work.

do_not_have.question: What are the parcel's actual seismic, flood and fire zone statuses?
do_not_have.why_blocks: W-04 exists to replace regional hazard context with actual zone status. Until this closes, the site can only show that the method works at a reference point.
do_not_have.holder: Owner / public records once address is known
do_not_have.discovery: Run the three queries with the parcel coordinates; confirm fire on the official OSFM viewer; order a property condition and seismic assessment.
do_not_have.privacy_safe: Yes for the zone lookup. No for the assessment, which names the address.

do_not_have.question: What is the exact lease expiration date, and what renewal options exist?
do_not_have.why_blocks: The brief says 2030-2035. That eight-year spread is the difference between a 3-year and a 9-year asset. It changes the answer more than any forecast in this project.
do_not_have.discovery: Lease abstract by a qualified abstractor. Only dates and structure need to leave the private workspace.
do_not_have.privacy_safe: Yes — dates carry no personal information.

do_not_have.question: What is the contract rent, and are all three nets truly recovered?
do_not_have.why_blocks: Drives NOI and therefore both the sale value and the hold value.
do_not_have.discovery: Rent roll plus three years of expense reconciliations.
do_not_have.privacy_safe: No — must stay private. Entered only into the browser calculator.

do_not_have.question: What cap rate will a buyer actually pay for this asset, and what discount applies to its remaining term?
do_not_have.why_blocks: There is no official source for single-tenant QSR cap rates. Every sell-side number depends on this.
do_not_have.discovery: Engage two or three brokers for a written opinion under NDA; obtain one appraisal. Record quotes as spreads over the verified 4.91% Treasury.
do_not_have.privacy_safe: No — quotes are asset-specific and confidential.

do_not_have.question: What is the adjusted basis and accumulated depreciation?
do_not_have.why_blocks: Without it there is no after-tax comparison, only a pre-tax one, which understates the cost of selling.
do_not_have.holder: Owner's CPA / tax returns and depreciation schedules
do_not_have.discovery: Request the depreciation schedule and prior returns from the preparer.

do_not_have.question: What is the current insurance premium, and what exactly does the policy cover?
do_not_have.why_blocks: Post-2025 California repricing makes insurance a top-three expense and the main unquantified hold risk.
do_not_have.discovery: Read the binder: limits, deductibles, business-interruption period, flood and earthquake sub-limits, exclusions, renewal date.
do_not_have.privacy_safe: No — private, but only the premium and coverage shape are needed for the model.

do_not_have.question: Is there debt on the property, and does it have a prepayment penalty or lockout?
do_not_have.why_blocks: Changes net sale proceeds and can make a sale uneconomic in a given window.

do_not_have.question: Are there unremediated building deficiencies — seismic, accessibility, roof, HVAC?
do_not_have.why_blocks: Buyers price these in; a hold has to pay for them.
do_not_have.holder: Property condition assessor; City of Los Angeles records
do_not_have.discovery: Commission a property condition assessment; pull permit history and any retrofit orders.
do_not_have.privacy_safe: Mixed — the report is private, the permit history is public.

do_not_have.question: What is the competitive set within 1, 3 and 5 miles?
do_not_have.why_blocks: Tenant renewal intent is a function of store performance, which is a function of nearby competition and traffic.
do_not_have.holder: Licensed data vendor or field survey
do_not_have.discovery: Field survey of QSR units in the ring, or a licensed location-intelligence subscription. Note that vendor data is not official and must be labelled as such.

do_not_have.question: What is the actual traffic count on the adjacent street?
do_not_have.why_blocks: AADT is the standard QSR demand proxy and a major rent driver.
do_not_have.holder: Caltrans for state highways; City of Los Angeles for surface streets
do_not_have.discovery: Caltrans publishes AADT files by segment (see S-010). City streets require the city traffic engineering office.
do_not_have.note: Cannot be pulled until the adjacent segment is known — blocked by G-01.

do_not_have.question: Is the tenant franchisee creditworthy, and what does the guaranty actually cover?
do_not_have.why_blocks: The lease is only as good as the operator behind it. Jack in the Box the brand is not the same credit as the franchisee entity.
do_not_have.discovery: Request franchisee financial statements and the guaranty. Public brand filings (S-011) do not substitute.

do_not_have.question: What is the owner's own liquidity position and concentration?
do_not_have.why_blocks: The best property decision can still be wrong for the person if it leaves them illiquid or over-concentrated.
do_not_have.discovery: Internal net-worth and liquidity statement, reviewed with an adviser. Never published.

do_not_have.question: What are the 2026 California PIT tax brackets and MHSA surcharge?
do_not_have.why_blocks: Previously open (IR-06) because the 540 booklet failed to load. Now verified from FTB Tax News Oct 2026 (Schedules X/Y/Z 1.00%-12.30%) and FTB 5805F (+1% MHSA > $1M). Only the owner's personal taxable-income tier remains private.
do_not_have.holder: California FTB (verified) / Owner for personal tier
do_not_have.discovery: Verified 2026 brackets embedded in assets/js/calc.js from S-033 and S-034.
do_not_have.privacy_safe: Yes — statutory brackets are public; personal income stays in browser.

do_not_have.question: What is the parcel's zoning, Community Plan designation and Transit Oriented Communities (TOC) tier?
do_not_have.why_blocks: Determines whether post-2030 redevelopment or higher-density land value exceeds the QSR pad hold value.
do_not_have.discovery: Query zimas.lacity.org by parcel APN/address in the secure workspace per CP-7826 guidelines (S-028).
do_not_have.privacy_safe: Yes — zoning and TOC tier can be summarised without publishing the address.

do_not_have.question: Can the parcel-level cash-flow model be back-tested against local QSR sale/rent history?
do_not_have.why_blocks: Currently only the macro HPI mean-reversion rule is back-tested (r = -0.937); parcel-level underwriting remains unbacktested (F-20).
do_not_have.holder: Appraiser / broker comps + owner rent history
do_not_have.discovery: Once G-04, G-05 and G-06 close, test model cap-rate and rent assumptions against at least 3 closed central-LA QSR comps.
do_not_have.privacy_safe: Mixed — anonymised comp spreads can be published; lease rent stays private.

answered_by_design.question: Should this site publish the parcel address or owner identity?
answered_by_design.answer: No. Never. See PRIVACY.md. The site is built so that it is useful with the address removed.

answered_by_design.question: Should a sell or renew recommendation be published now?
answered_by_design.answer: No. Both sides are missing every property-level input. Publishing a verdict would require inventing inputs, which the owner prohibited. The site publishes the decision rule and the gates instead.

answered_by_design.question: Should a cap rate be assumed for illustration?
answered_by_design.answer: No. A cap rate multiplies directly into value; an assumed one would silently become the answer. The calculator takes it as a reader input.

sequence.why_order_matters: G-01 unlocks G-03 and G-12. G-04 is independent and can start today. G-02 is free and unlocks the whole of W-01. Doing G-06 before G-04 would price the wrong asset.
